岡山県南部、[[小田川 (高梁川水系)|小田川]]支流の二万谷川が形成する谷の東側に築造された古墳である。現在では後円部の石室前に迩摩神社が所在する。[[2001年|2001]]-[[2004年]]度（[[平成]]13-16年度）に発掘調査が実施されている。 墳形は前方部が発達した前方後円形で、前方部を西方向に向ける。墳丘は2段築成{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。墳丘外表では[[円筒埴輪]]列（朝顔形埴輪含む）が検出されているが、[[葺石]]は認められない{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。また墳丘北側くびれ部には[[造出]]を付し、人物埴輪・家形埴輪・[[須恵器]]が検出されている{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。墳丘周囲に周濠・周堤は認められていない{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。埋葬施設は両袖式の[[横穴式石室]]で、南南西方向に開口し、内部に木棺を据えたと見られる。石室内の調査では、銅鏡・装身具・武器・工具・馬具・[[須恵器]]・[[土師器]]など多数の副葬品が検出されている。 築造時期は、[[古墳時代]]後期の[[6世紀]]中葉頃（TK10型式期）と推定され、その後の追葬が認められる{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。小規模ながら高梁川西岸では最終段階かつ唯一の前方後円墳であり、渡来系要素の強い中期の[[天狗山古墳]]（倉敷市下二万・川辺）とは異なる定型的前方後円墳として注目される{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。また吉備地方では最古期の横穴式石室を有する点で特筆され、6世紀後半の[[江崎古墳]]・[[こうもり塚古墳]]（[[総社市]]）の存在を考え合わせて、当時の吉備地方の政治情勢を考察するうえで重要視される古墳になる。 古墳域は[[2005年]]（平成17年）に倉敷市指定史跡に指定されている。 == 遺跡歴 == * [[2001年|2001]]-[[2004年]]度（[[平成]]13-16年度）、発掘調査（[[岡山大学]]考古学研究室、[[2018年]]に報告書刊行）{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 * [[2005年]]（平成17年）12月5日、倉敷市指定史跡に指定。 == 墳丘 == 墳丘の規模は次の通り{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 * 墳丘長：38メートル * 後円部 - 2段築成。 ** 直径：22.5メートル ** 高さ：4.46メートル * 前方部 - 2段築成。 ** 長さ：15.5メートル ** 幅：24メートル ** 高さ：5.7メートル 墳丘のテラスおよび埴輪列は、墳丘北側（墳丘片側）でのみ検出されている。墳丘主軸の後円部端・前方部端ではテラスは検出されていないものの多量の埴輪片が出土しており、テラス・埴輪列は元々全体に存在したか（テラス・埴輪列とも流失）、墳丘北側のみで全体には存在しなかったか（テラスはなく埴輪は墳頂から転落）は明確でない{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 墳丘の北側テラスでは、[[造出]]が段差の無い形で取り付く。造出は地山削り出しによって構築されており、長さ5.6メートル・最大幅9.2メートルを測る{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。造出の方形平坦面では、南辺に墳丘テラスの埴輪列があり、他の辺にも埴輪列を設置して方形埴輪区画を形成したと見られる（ただし北辺は残存せず、東辺・西辺の途中で途切れる）{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。平坦面南西側（墳丘側）では[[形象埴輪]]（家形埴輪・人物埴輪）が、平坦面北側・裾部では[[須恵器]]片（坏身1・甕3・脚付壺1）が検出されている{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 また調査では、各トレンチで墳頂からの転落等と見られる埴輪片・須恵器片（坏蓋・坏身・壺・脚付壺・器台・甕）・手捏土器・鉄滓などが出土している{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 == 埋葬施設 == 埋葬施設としては後円部において両袖式[[横穴式石室]]が構築されており、南南西方向に開口する。石室の規模は次の通り。 * 石室全長：9.10メートル * 玄室：長さ4.69メートル（主軸上）、幅2.24-2.48メートル、高さ2.50メートル * 羨道：長さ4.41メートル（主軸上）、幅0.83-0.88メートル、高さ1.40-1.65メートル 石室の石材は小ぶりな割石である。玄室の奥壁は5-6段積み、東壁は7段積み、西壁は7-8段積み{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。羨道の東壁は3-7段積み、西壁は3-5段積み{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。天井石は、玄室では5石、羨道では5石の計10石{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。羨道部中央には排水溝が認められる{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 石室内からは鉄釘・鎹が出土していることから、木棺の使用が推測される。ただし木棺および人骨の痕跡は確認されていない{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 == 出土品 == 石室内の調査で検出された副葬品は次の通り{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}}。 * 獣形鏡 - 直径11.7-12.0センチメートル。 * 装身具 ** 銅釧 1 ** 耳環 7 ** 玉 1215 - 空玉7、碧玉製管玉8、水晶製算盤玉4、琥珀製棗玉10、ガラス製トンボ玉5、ガラス製丸玉2、石製臼玉1、ガラス製小玉1103、土製勾玉1、土製丸玉61。 * 武器 ** 直刀 5 - 大刀3、小刀2。 ** 蕨手状柄付鉄器 2 ** 鉄鏃 170以上 - 細根式159、平根式11、小片多数。 ** 胡簶・靫金具片 * 工具 ** 刀子 6 ** 曲刀子 2 ** 鉄製握り鋏 1（2点同一個体か） * 馬具 ** 轡 - 素環状鏡板付轡1、f字形鏡板付轡1。 ** 鞍金具 - 前輪磯金具1組、鞖金具。 ** 輪鐙・鐙吊り金具 - 輪鐙1、鐙吊り金具6。 ** 雲珠・辻金具 - 雲珠1、辻金具3、雲珠・辻金具に伴う脚部30、花形座1。 ** 杏葉 - 剣菱形杏葉4、変形剣菱形杏葉4、棘葉形杏葉3。 ** 馬齢 - 八角形鈴2、小型球形鈴9。 ** 鉸具・革金具 * 鉄釘・鎹 - 鉄釘45、鎹2、釘または鎹7。 * [[須恵器]] - 坏蓋20、無蓋高坏13、有蓋高坏2、高坏蓋1、𤭯4、短頸壺3、短頸壺蓋2、脚付長頸壺1、脚付長頸壺蓋2、壺類7、横瓶2、提瓶1、器台2、装飾付須恵器、甕など。 * [[土師器]] - 高坏2、特殊高坏1、壺1、ミニチュア土器など。 == 文化財 == === 倉敷市指定文化財 === * 史跡 ** 二万大塚古墳 - 所有者は迩摩神社。2005年（平成17年）12月5日指定[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳]（倉敷市ホームページ）。。 == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist}} == 参考文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用した文献）}} * 史跡説明板（倉敷市教育委員会設置） * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=1988|chapter=二万塚古墳|title=岡山県の地名|series=[[日本歴史地名大系]]34|publisher=[[平凡社]]|isbn=4582490344|ref={{Harvid|二万塚古墳（平凡社）|1988}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=岡山大学考古学研究室|author=|year=2018|chapter=|title=[https://sitereports.nabunken.go.jp/35948 二万大塚古墳]|publisher=二万大塚古墳発掘調査団|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|二万大塚古墳|2018}}}} - リンクは奈良文化財研究所「全国遺跡報告総覧」。 == 関連文献 == {{small|（記事執筆に使用していない関連文献）}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=2001|chapter=|title=二万大塚古墳 -岡山県吉備郡真備町-|publisher=岡山大学考古学研究室|isbn=|ref=}} == 関連項目 == * [[天狗山古墳]] * [[箭田大塚古墳]] == 外部リンク == * [https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] - Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery}}, {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery}}, {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪}} |陪塚 = |built = Mid-{{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀}} |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a {{ill|Kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun}}, located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of {{ill|Kurashiki|ja|倉敷市}}, {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|ja|岡山県}}. It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||{{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun}}||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |{{ill|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|ja|箭田大塚古墳|lt=Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|lt_ja=箭田大塚古墳}}||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|12=draft}}, {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|12=draft}}, {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪|12=draft}} |陪塚 = |built = Mid-{{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀|12=draft}} |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a {{ill|Kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun|12=draft}}, located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of {{ill|Kurashiki|ja|倉敷市|12=draft}}, {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|ja|岡山県|12=draft}}. It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|12=draft}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|12=draft}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|12=draft}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||{{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|12=draft}}||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |{{ill|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|ja|箭田大塚古墳|lt=Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|lt_ja=箭田大塚古墳|12=draft}}||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|12=draft}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|12=draft}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|12=draft}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|12=draft}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|12=draft}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|12=draft}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|12=draft}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|12=draft}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|12=draft}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|12=draft}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|12=draft}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|12=draft}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in 古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a {{ill|Kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun|12=draft}}, located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of {{ill|Kurashiki|ja|倉敷市|12=draft}}, {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|ja|岡山県|12=draft}}. It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|12=draft}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|12=draft}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|12=draft}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||{{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|12=draft}}||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |{{ill|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|ja|箭田大塚古墳|lt=Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|lt_ja=箭田大塚古墳|12=draft}}||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|12=draft}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|12=draft}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|12=draft}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|12=draft}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|12=draft}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|12=draft}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|12=draft}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|12=draft}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|12=draft}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|12=draft}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|12=draft}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|12=draft}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|12=draft}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|12=draft}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|qq=draft}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft}}. It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==

This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft}}, {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft}}, {{ill|Haniwa|ja|埴輪|qq=draft}} |陪塚 = |built = Mid-{{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀|qq=draft}} |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a {{ill|Kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun|qq=draft}}, located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of {{ill|Kurashiki|ja|倉敷市|qq=draft}}, {{ill|Okayama Prefecture|ja|岡山県|qq=draft}}. It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||{{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft}}||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |{{ill|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|ja|箭田大塚古墳|lt=Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|lt_ja=箭田大塚古墳|qq=draft}}||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|qq=draft}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|qq=draft}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|qq=draft}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in writing this article)}} * Intypeation board (posted by Kurashiki City Board of Education) * {{Cite book|和書|editor=|author=|year=1988|chapter=二万塚古墳|title=岡山県の地名|series={{ill|Nihon Rekishi Chimei Taikei|ja|日本歴史地名大系|qq=draft}}34|publisher={{ill|Heibonsha|ja|平凡社|qq=draft}}|isbn=4582490344|ref={{Harvid|二万塚古墳（平凡社）|1988}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|editor={{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|qq=draft}} It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpokoenfun|qq=}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pit-type stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||{{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpokoenfun|qq=}}||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |{{ill|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|ja|箭田大塚古墳|lt=Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|lt_ja=箭田大塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōmori-zuka Kofun|qq=}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sōja, Okayama|qq=}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okayama University|qq=}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|qq=}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōmori-zuka Kofun|qq=}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sōja, Okayama|qq=}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okayama University|qq=}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|qq=}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōmori-zuka Kofun|qq=}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sōja, Okayama|qq=}}). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of {{ill|Okayama University|ja|岡山大学|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Okayama University|qq=}} (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|qq=}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in
