It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}}: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * {{ill|Haji pottery|ja|土師器|1=Haji pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Haji pottery|qq=}}: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. It is a {{ill|Keyhole-shaped kofun|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|2=ja|3=前方後円墳|4=ko|5=전방후원분|6=zh|7=前方後圓墳|lt=Zenpokoenfun|comement=second one attempting to fix this error|lt=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|comment=doing this because I need to differentiate it in piped links too with my new interwiki tool as not the ambiguous phrase keyhole shaped kofun|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Keyhole-shaped kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Zenpokoenfun|qq=}} and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==

This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue pottery|qq=}} were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and {{ill|Kōmorizuka Kofun|lt=Kōmorizuka Kofun|lt=Kōmori-zuka Kofun|ja|こうもり塚古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōmori-zuka Kofun|qq=}} (in {{ill|Sōja, Okayama|ja|総社市|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sōja, Okayama|qq=}}). Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * {{ill|Sue pottery|ja|須恵器|1=Sue pottery|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sue Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]], [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]], [[:en:Haniwa|Haniwa]] |陪塚 = |built = Mid-[[:en:6th century|6th century]] |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]], located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of [[:en:Kurashiki|Kurashiki]], [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]]. It is a [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pit-type stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||[[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]]||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |[[:en:Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun]]||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]] were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]], [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]], [[:en:Haniwa|Haniwa]] |陪塚 = |built = Mid-[[:en:6th century|6th century]] |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]], located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of [[:en:Kurashiki|Kurashiki]], [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]]. It is a [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pit-type stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||[[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]]||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |[[:en:Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun]]||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]] were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]]: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in 二万大塚古墳]|publisher=二万大塚古墳発掘調査団|isbn=|ref={{Harvid|二万大塚古墳|2018}}}} – Link via Nara National Research Institute for Historic Site “Zenkoku Iseki Hōkoku Sōran” (Nationwide Archaeological Site Report Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]]: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]], [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]], [[:en:Haniwa|Haniwa]] |陪塚 = |built = Mid-[[:en:6th century|6th century]] |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]], located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of [[:en:Kurashiki|Kurashiki]], [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]]. It is a [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pit-type stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||[[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]]||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |[[:en:Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun]]||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]] were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]]: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in 古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]], located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of [[:en:Kurashiki|Kurashiki]], [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]]. It is a [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pit-type stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||[[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]]||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |[[:en:Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun]]||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]] were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]]: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]]: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=}}. Height: 5.7 m (front area) |Burial Facility = Two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} (with wooden coffin inside) |burial goods = Numerous burial goods, [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]], [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]], [[:en:Haniwa|Haniwa]] |陪塚 = |built = Mid-[[:en:6th century|6th century]] |Interred Persons = |陵墓 = |史跡 = Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site: “Nima Ōtsuka Kofun” |有形文化財 = |Special Notes = |地図2={{location map|Japan Okayama|map_dot_label=二万大塚
古墳|coordinates=34|coordinates=37|coordinates=15.37|lon_deg=133|lon_min=42|lon_sec=28.37|mark=前方後円墳-西.svg|marksize=28|float=center|border=none|position=top|width=200|caption=}} {{maplink2|frame=yes|plain=yes|type=point|zoom=13|frame-align=center|frame-width=200|coord={{coord|34|37|15.37|N|133|42|28.37|E}}}} }} '''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun''' (二万大塚古墳) is a [[:en:Kofun|Kofun]], located in the Shimo Nima (下二万) area of [[:en:Kurashiki|Kurashiki]], [[:en:Okayama Prefecture|Okayama Prefecture]]. It is a [[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]] and has been Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City. == Overview ==
{| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%;" |+ !Kofun name!!type!!area!!burial!!built!!Historic Site |- |{{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|lt=Tenguyama Kofun|lt_ja=天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}}||{{ill|Scallop-shaped Kofun|ja|帆立貝形古墳|1=Scallop Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop-shaped Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Scallop Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}||Kofun length: 60 m||{{ill|Pit-type stone chamber|ja|竪穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=竪穴式石室|4=zh|5=豎穴式石室|1=Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Pit-type stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Vertical Pit-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Late 5th century–end of 5th century||Municipal |- |'''Nima Ōtsuka Kofun'''||[[:en:Zenpokoenfun|Zenpokoenfun]]||Kofun length: 38 m||{{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}}||Mid-6th century||Municipal |- |[[:en:Yata Ōtsuka Kofun|Yata Ōtsuka Kofun]]||{{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|1=Round Kofun|1=Round Kofun|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|13=User:Immanuelle/Round Kofun|qq=|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}||Diameter: 46 m||Horizontal stone chamber||Late 6th century||National |}
This tumulus was built on the eastern side of a valley typeed by the {{ill|Nima-tani River|ja|小田川 (高梁川水系)|lt=Oda River (Takahashi River system)|lt_ja=小田川|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima-tani River|qq=}}’s tributary, in the southern part of Okayama Prefecture. Today, {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} stands in front of the stone chamber of the posterior circular portion. Excavations were carried out from [[2001]] to [[2004]] (Heisei 13–16). The tumulus is a two-tiered keyhole-shaped mound with its front part oriented to the west.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} An arrangement of {{ill|Cylindrical haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|1=Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical haniwa|13=User:Immanuelle/Cylindrical Haniwa|qq=}} (including morning glory–shaped types) was found on the mound surface, but no paving stones (葺石) were identified.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) was constructed on the north side of the constricted section, where human-shaped haniwa, house-shaped haniwa, and [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]] were found.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There is no evidence of a surrounding moat or embankment.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The burial facility is a two-sided horizontal stone chamber opening to the south-southwest, where a wooden coffin is believed to have been placed. Numerous grave goods were discovered in the chamber, including bronze mirrors, ornaments, weapons, tools, horse tack, and Sue/Haji potterys. Based on typology (TK10 style), the tumulus was built around the mid-6th century (late Kofun period), with evidence of subsequent secondary burials.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Though small, it is the only and final-phase keyhole-shaped kofun on the western side of the Takahashi River, differing from the more strongly continental-style mid-5th-century {{ill|Tengu-yama Kofun|ja|天狗山古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tengu-yama Kofun|qq=}} (Shimo Nima/Kawabe, Kurashiki City).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} It has one of the earliest horizontal stone chambers in the Kibi region, making it important for understanding the political dynamics of Kibi in this period, along with the late 6th-century {{ill|Ezaki Kofun|ja|江崎古墳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ezaki Kofun|qq=}} and [[:en:Kōmorizuka Kofun|Kōmori-zuka Kofun]] (in [[:en:Sōja|Sōja, Okayama]]). The site was Historic Site1 as a municipal historic site by Kurashiki City in [[2005]] (Heisei 17). == Excavation History == * [[2001]]–[[2004]] (Heisei 13–16): Excavations by the Archaeology Laboratory of [[:en:Okayama University|Okayama University]] (published 2018).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * [[2005]] (Heisei 17) December 5: Designated a Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site. == Kofun == The mound area are as follows:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Total length: 38 meters * Posterior circular portion (two-tier construction): ** Diameter: 22.5 m ** Height: 4.46 m * Anterior rectangular portion (two-tier construction): ** Length: 15.5 m ** Width: 24 m ** Height: 5.7 m Terraces and haniwa rows were identified only on the north side. Although no terraces were discovered at the endpoints of the main mound axis, large quantities of haniwa fragments were found, so it remains unclear whether such structures were once continuous but later eroded away, or were never present all around.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A plattype (造出) without a stepped boundary is attached on the north side terrace. It was typeed by carving the natural ground; its total length is about 5.6 m, with a maximum width of 9.2 m.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Along the south edge, a haniwa row was found, and likely haniwa rows originally existed on all sides (though the north side is no longer preserved).{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} On the southwestern side (mound side), house-shaped and human-shaped haniwa were discovered, while Sue pottery fragments (bowl, jar, and footed jar) were found toward the northern edge.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} In the excavation trenches around the mound, numerous fragments of haniwa and Sue pottery (bowls with and without lids, jars, footed jars, stands, etc.), hand-molded pottery, and iron slag were recovered—likely the result of wash-off or collapse from the mound apex.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial == A two-sided {{ill|horizontal stone chamber|ja|横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|2=ja|3=横穴式石室|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|4=zh|5=橫穴式石室|6=ko|7=굴식 돌방무덤|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|1=Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/horizontal stone chamber|13=User:Immanuelle/Corridor-Style Stone Chamber|qq=}} was built in the posterior circular portion, opening to the south-southwest. Its area are as follows: * Total length of stone chamber: 9.10 m * Main chamber: 4.69 m long (along the axis), 2.24–2.48 m wide, 2.50 m high * Entrance corridor: 4.41 m long (along the axis), 0.83–0.88 m wide, 1.40–1.65 m high The chamber is constructed of relatively small cut stones. The back wall of the main chamber comprises 5–6 courses of stone, the east wall has 7 courses, and the west wall 7–8 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} The east corridor wall has 3–7 courses, and the west corridor wall 3–5 courses.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} There are 10 ceiling stones in total: 5 in the main chamber and 5 in the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} A drainage channel is present in the center of the corridor.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} Iron nails and clamps suggest that a wooden coffin was used, although no direct remains of the coffin or human bones were discovered.{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} == burial goods == burial goods discovered in the stone chamber include the following:{{Sfn|二万大塚古墳|2018}} * Beast-motif mirror (獣形鏡), diameter 11.7–12.0 cm * Personal ornaments ** Bronze bracelet (銅釧) x1 ** Earrings (耳環) x7 ** Beads x1215: *** Hollow beads x7 *** Tubular beads (jade) x8 *** Abacus-shaped beads (crystal) x4 *** Jujube-shaped beads (amber) x10 *** Tōnbo-dama (glass) x5 *** Spherical glass beads x2 *** Stone beads x1 *** Small glass beads x1103 *** Clay magatama x1 *** Clay beads x61 * Weapons ** Straight swords (直刀) x5 (3 large swords, 2 small swords) ** Warabite-shaped hilt ironware (蕨手状柄付鉄器) x2 ** Iron arrowheads x170+ (159 slender type, 11 flat type, plus many fragments) ** Quiver fittings * Tools ** Knives (刀子) x6 ** Curved knives (曲刀子) x2 ** Iron scissors (握り鋏) x1 (possibly 2 fragments of a single item) * Horse tack ** Bits: *** Mirror-plate bit with plain rings x1 *** Mirror-plate bit with “f” type x1 ** Saddle fittings: *** Complete front pommel fittings x1 set *** “Shio” fittings ** Ring stirrup, stirrup-hanging fittings: *** Ring stirrup x1 *** Stirrup-hanging fittings x6 ** Unju, Tsuji fittings: *** 1 unju *** 3 tsuji fittings *** 30 leg parts related to unju/tsuji fittings *** 1 flower-shaped seat ** Ase-leaf (杏葉): *** Diamond-shaped type x4 *** Variant diamond-shaped x4 *** Thorn-leaf type x3 ** Horse bells: *** Octagonal bells x2 *** Small spherical bells x9 ** Hinges and leather fittings * Iron nails (45), clamps (2), plus 7 unidentified (nail or clamp) * [[:en:Sue pottery|Sue pottery]]: bowl lids (20), lidless bowls (13), lidded bowls (2), bowl lid (1), okoku (𤭯) (4), short-neck jars (3), jar lids (2), footed long-neck jar (1) with 2 lids, other jars (7), side-spout jars (2), handled jar (1), stands (2), decorative pieces, large jars, etc. * [[:en:Haji pottery|Haji pottery]]: raised bowls (2), special raised bowl (1), jar (1), miniature vessels, etc. == Historic Site == === Kurashiki Municipal Historic Site === * Historic Site ** Nima Ōtsuka Kofun – Owned by {{ill|Nima Shrine|ja|迩摩神社|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nima Shrine|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. Designated on December 5, 2005 (Heisei 17).[https://www.city.kurashiki.okayama.jp/5534.htm 二万大塚古墳] (Kurashiki City website). == Footnotes == {{reflist}} == References == {{small|(References used in
